title: Data flow diagrams
intro: Level 0 shows O2S and everything it talks to. Level 1 shows, for each process, what data moves between which data lists, named as they are in the data (orders, orders[].lines[], batches, batches[].lots[], packingLog, shipments and so on), with the o2s.html function that moves it. Level 2 lists every move for the processes with more than 6. Traced from build 2026-10-15g.

items.title: Level 0: O2S and everything it talks to

blocks.p: O2S is 1 browser app (o2s.html) used by every role. It keeps all its data as 1 record set on the server and pulls or pushes it whole. Nothing else writes O2S data. The only outside reader is the public batch check for van.com.pk, which is read-only.

list: People: Finance, Finance Desk Officer, KAM, CFO, COO, Supply Chain, Supply Chain Officer, Warehouse, Production, Production Manager, Plant Manager, Lab Rep, AQCM, QCM, QA Inspector. Each signs in with his own login; the role decides the buttons.
Browser app: o2s.html, served by the server at /o2s (the catch-all route).
Server: the O2S routes in server.js and the store behind them (getState, setState, setStateGuarded, listUsers).
Platform: sign-in and the module roles table (user_module_roles), shared with PD.
van.com.pk: the public lab report check, by the batch number printed on the bag.
Printed papers: PO, delivery challan (DC), gate pass, pre-shipment inspection report (PSI), COA, inspection log, lab assignment sheet, FOC sample DC and gate pass.

items.title: Level 1: public batch check for van.com.pk
items.ask: The public check uses the list users to tell a person's name from a role name, but the server strips users out of the saved O2S data. Is that list there to read? a) no, only masters.roles and the fixed role words are used, which is enough b) yes, users are stored with the state some other way c) not sure, check it
